welcome:
Welcome to STOR24.
Storage at Midpoint, made simple.

Tap Choose an option below to get started.

flows.title: Prices and availability
flows.text:
Prices depend on unit size and current availability. View the latest Midpoint units, monthly rental and booking details here: https://stor24.co.za/book
For Micro Warehousing: https://stor24.co.za/micro-warehousing
Please check the full quote for applicable deposits, once-off fees and other charges. I cannot hold stock or guarantee a price in this chat.

flows.title: Unit size guide
flows.text:
Choose a unit based on your items, not only the number of rooms. Try the 3D space guide: https://stor24.co.za/space-guide
Include boxes, furniture, appliances, bulky items and any aisle you need for access. The calculator is guidance, not a guarantee that every item will fit through the door. Staff can help check bulky items before you book.

flows.title: Business and Micro Warehousing
flows.text:
STOR24 offers business storage and Micro Warehousing for stock, equipment, tools, files and other permitted business items. Explore the spaces and current options: https://stor24.co.za/micro-warehousing
For advice, tell staff about your stock, volume, access frequency, deliveries and intended use. Staff must confirm suitability and any delivery or operating arrangements. Storage is not permission to run an unapproved business activity from a unit.

flows.title: Booking and viewing
flows.text:
Choose live units and start your booking at https://stor24.co.za/book
Follow the secure booking steps for contact verification, documents, agreements and the selected payment method. A hold or enquiry is not confirmation that you can move in. Staff confirm readiness and access. To arrange a viewing, type STAFF and provide your preferred date and time; appointments are subject to confirmation. Keep OTPs in the booking screen, never this chat.

flows.title: Location and hours
flows.text:
STOR24 currently directs online bookings to Store 1 — Midpoint. Melrose is listed as coming soon; do not assume it is available to book.
Current store contact details and directions: https://stor24.co.za/contact
Access and reception/viewing hours can differ. Ask staff to confirm the hours and your access arrangements before visiting; this bot does not promise 24-hour access.

flows.title: FAQ topic menu
flows.text:
Choose a topic by typing the word:
ACCESS — hours and authorised people
SECURITY — facility precautions
TERMS — rental duration, fees and changes
PAYMENT — payment guidance
DOCUMENTS — booking requirements
PACKING — furniture and boxes
PROHIBITED — items you may not store
INSURANCE — cover questions
TRANSPORT — collection or moving help
STUDENT — holidays and moving
CHANGE — larger units, cancellation or extensions
MY ACCOUNT — statements and documents
STAFF — personal assistance

Read the published FAQs: https://stor24.co.za/faq

flows.title: Customer account and OTP help
flows.text:
For your statements, documents and customer account, use the secure portal: https://portal.stor24.co.za/my
If a booking verification code is missing, use the resend option in your booking screen and check the channel shown there. This enquiry number is separate from STOR24’s verification/notification sender. Do not post an OTP or password in chat. Staff can help with account or booking problems; I cannot see your balance, authenticate you or change your account.

flows.title: Access and authorised visitors
flows.text:
Unit access depends on the facility rules and your approved access arrangements. Ask the Midpoint team to confirm access hours before visiting.
Another person may access a unit only after the facility has approved the required authorisation and identification arrangements. Please contact staff first. This bot cannot open gates, issue access codes, register biometrics or override access restrictions.

flows.title: Security
flows.text: STOR24’s published information describes controlled access, CCTV and monitored premises. Ask the Midpoint team about the specific arrangements that apply to your unit. Security precautions are not a guarantee against loss or damage. For an urgent security or access problem, call +27 11 380 9400; this bot is not an emergency response service.

flows.title: Rental terms and fees
flows.text:
Flexible short- and long-term storage options may be available. The agreed rental period, notice requirements, deposits and any once-off or additional charges must be confirmed in your quotation and agreement.
Read the current terms: https://stor24.co.za/terms
A general FAQ answer does not change your signed agreement. Staff can explain the applicable commercial terms.

flows.title: Payments and refunds
flows.text:
Follow the payment instructions in your secure booking journey or customer account: https://portal.stor24.co.za/my
Available methods and requirements depend on your booking. Mandate signing, payment settlement and move-in/access approval are separate steps. I cannot confirm a payment, promise a refund, change a debit order or release an account restriction. For billing help, select STAFF. Do not send card details, bank-account details, payment credentials or OTPs here.

flows.title: Booking documents
flows.text:
Booking may require identification or a passport, proof of address, contact details and relevant company documents for business rentals. Follow the instructions in the secure booking journey: https://stor24.co.za/book
Please upload sensitive documents only through the approved secure process; do not send ID/passport images or bank documents to this bot. Staff confirm the exact requirements for your booking.

flows.title: Packing and household furniture
flows.text: Household furniture, appliances, clothing, boxes and other permitted personal belongings can be stored. Pack items securely, label boxes and protect fragile pieces. Empty and dry appliances, avoid packing damp items and allow space for access if needed. Bring the measurements of bulky items so staff can check doorway clearance and practical fit. Size guide: https://stor24.co.za/space-guide

flows.title: Prohibited items
flows.text:
Do not store illegal goods, explosives, flammable materials, dangerous chemicals, perishable food, live animals, or anything that could damage the facility or other customers’ belongings. Check the current agreement and ask staff before bringing an item you are unsure about: https://stor24.co.za/terms
For immediate danger, use the appropriate emergency service; do not wait for a chat reply.

flows.title: Insurance
flows.text: Ask staff to confirm the insurance requirements for your storage agreement. Check whether your household or business policy covers belongings kept in storage, including its exclusions and limits. This bot cannot arrange cover, assess a claim or confirm that an item is insured.

flows.title: Transport and collection
flows.text: Transport or collection assistance may be possible, depending on your location and items. Ask staff to confirm availability, charges, booking and delivery/loading arrangements before making plans. Tell them your collection area, main items, stairs/access constraints and preferred date. No transport booking is confirmed by this bot.

flows.title: Students and moving
flows.text: Storage can help between student terms, residences, moves or renovations. Share your items, planned start date and expected duration with staff. Check the agreement’s minimum period, notice and fees rather than assuming a special student rate. Find available Midpoint units: https://stor24.co.za/book

flows.title: Unit changes cancellation and extensions
flows.text: A larger or smaller unit depends on availability and staff approval. Extensions, cancellations and move-out arrangements must follow your agreement and any notice requirements. Contact staff before changing your plans. I cannot cancel a booking, terminate a lease, amend rent or confirm a refund in chat. Use the secure portal for your documents: https://portal.stor24.co.za/my

flows.title: Problems complaints and urgent help
flows.text:
For a booking, billing, access or service problem, select STAFF and describe what happened. You may include your booking reference, but do not send passwords, OTPs, identity documents or bank details.
Midpoint contact: +27 11 380 9400 / bookings@stor24.co.za
Our team will respond when available; this bot does not promise an immediate reply or emergency attendance.

flows.title: Privacy and contact preferences
flows.text:
We use your enquiry details to respond to your storage request. An enquiry does not subscribe you to marketing. Read the privacy notice: https://stor24.co.za/privacy
Do not send sensitive documents, financial credentials, passwords or OTPs in this chat. For privacy requests or contact-preference changes, select STAFF. STOP can be used to opt out of this bot’s subscription; it does not cancel a rental agreement or change separate STOR24 operational notifications.

staffIntro:
Need a person? Tap Speak to staff below to pause the bot and request help in our shared inbox.
Then send your name, whether you need personal or business storage, your main items, preferred start date and duration, or a short description of your problem.
Our team will reply when available. For time-sensitive help: +27 11 380 9400 or bookings@stor24.co.za. Do not send OTPs, passwords, ID documents or bank details.
stopText: To opt out of this STOR24 bot subscription, tap Stop bot messages below. This does not cancel a rental agreement or change your separate booking, payment or account notifications. For rental or account changes, contact +27 11 380 9400 / bookings@stor24.co.za.

defaultFirstContact.body:
Welcome to STOR24.
Find storage at Midpoint or get help from our team.

How can we help?
defaultFirstContact.footer: Never share OTPs, bank details or ID documents here.

questions.question:
Let`s find your space at Midpoint.

Is this for personal or business use?

What would you like to store?
For example: a sofa, a double bed and 10 boxes.

When would you like to start?
A date or `not sure` is fine.
How long do you expect to need the space?

What unit size do you have in mind?
Reply `not sure` if you`d like help choosing.
Would you like to view a unit before booking?
Lastly, what name should our team use?
